industrial-and-commercial-bank-of-china.name: Industrial and Commercial Bank of China
industrial-and-commercial-bank-of-china.legal_name: Industrial and Commercial Bank of China
industrial-and-commercial-bank-of-china.description: The Industrial and Commercial Bank of China (ICBC) is a partially state-owned multinational banking and financial services corporation headquartered in Beijing, China. It is the largest of the "big four" banks in China and the largest bank in the world by total assets. ICBC was created in 1984 from the commercial banking operations of the People's Bank of China.

listings.name: Industrial and Commercial Bank of China

ibm.name: IBM
ibm.description: International Business Machines Corporation (IBM) is an American multinational technology company headquartered in Armonk, New York, with presence in over 175 countries. It is the largest industrial research organization globally, holding the record for most annual U.S. patents generated by a business for 29 consecutive years.

infosys-limited.name: Infosys limited
infosys-limited.description: Infosys Limited is an Indian multinational technology company headquartered in Bengaluru. Founded in 1981 by seven engineers, it offers information technology, business consulting, and outsourcing services. It is considered one of the Big Six Indian IT companies.

itausa.name: Itaúsa
itausa.description: Itaúsa is a Brazilian multinational conglomerate holding company headquartered in São Paulo. Founded in 1966, it controls several companies active in finance, real estate, industrial, health, chemical, and fashion sectors. Notably, Itaúsa controls Itaú Unibanco, Duratex, and Alpargatas S.A.

international-airlines-group.name: International Airlines Group
international-airlines-group.description: International Consolidated Airlines Group S.A. (IAG) is an Anglo-Spanish multinational airline holding company with offices in Madrid and London. It was formed in 2011 after a merger between British Airways and Iberia, which became wholly owned subsidiaries.

indra-sistemas.name: Indra Sistemas
indra-sistemas.description: Indra Sistemas, S.A., also known as Indra Group, is a Spanish company specializing in information technology, transport technology, and defense. It is listed on the Bolsa de Madrid and is part of the IBEX 35 index.

international-paper.name: International Paper
international-paper.description: The International Paper Company is an American pulp and paper company headquartered in Memphis, Tennessee. It is the largest pulp and paper company in the world. The company employs approximately 39,000 people.

inventec.name: Inventec
inventec.description: Inventec Corporation is a Taiwan-based Original Design Manufacturer producing notebook computers, servers, and mobile devices. Established in 1975 initially for electronic calculators, its major customers include Hewlett-Packard, Toshiba, Acer, and Fujitsu-Siemens.

illinois-tool-works.name: Illinois Tool Works
illinois-tool-works.description: Illinois Tool Works Inc. is an American Fortune 500 company producing engineered fasteners, components, equipment, and specialty products. Founded in 1912, it has grown through a strategy focused on decentralization, simplicity, innovation, and acquisitions.

interpublic-group-of-companies.name: Interpublic Group of Companies
interpublic-group-of-companies.description: The Interpublic Group of Companies, Inc. was an American advertising company based in New York City. It included major networks such as FCB and McCann Worldgroup and was one of the 'Big Four' agency companies before being acquired by Omnicom in 2025.

iberdrola.name: Iberdrola
iberdrola.description: Iberdrola, S.A. is a Spanish multinational electric utility company headquartered in Bilbao, Spain. It employs around 40,000 people and serves approximately 30 million customers.

isbank.name: İşbank
isbank.description: İşbank, officially Türkiye İş Bankası, is a commercial bank in Turkey founded in 1924 by the orders of Mustafa Kemal Atatürk. It was the first bank to operate in the Republic of Türkiye.

israel-aerospace-industries-ltd.name: Israel Aerospace Industries Ltd
israel-aerospace-industries-ltd.description: Israel Aerospace Industries is Israel's major aerospace and aviation manufacturer producing aerial and astronautic systems for military and civilian use. It is state-owned by the government of Israel and employs thousands of people.

ina.name: INA
ina.description: INA-Industrija nafte, d.d. is a Croatian multinational oil company headquartered in Zagreb. It plays a leading role in Croatia's oil business, including exploration, production, processing, and distribution of oil and gas. The company is partly owned by the Hungarian MOL Group and the Croatian Government.

international.name: International
international.description: International Motors, LLC is an American manufacturer of commercial vehicles and engines established in 1986. It produces trucks under its own brand and buses under the IC Bus name and is an independent subsidiary of Traton since 2021.

indorama-ventures.name: Indorama Ventures
indorama-ventures.description: Indorama Ventures (IVL) is a producer in the intermediate petrochemicals industry and is the world's largest producer of PET resins. The company is based in Thailand.

itt-corporation.name: ITT Corporation
itt-corporation.description: ITT Inc. is an American manufacturing company based in Stamford, Connecticut. It produces specialty components for aerospace, transportation, energy, and industrial markets through its three business units.

illumina.name: Illumina
illumina.description: Illumina, Inc. is an American biotechnology company headquartered in San Diego, California. Founded in 1998, it develops and markets integrated systems for genetic variation and biological function analysis. Its products serve sequencing, genotyping, gene expression, and proteomics markets worldwide.

ing-bank-slaski.name: ING Bank Śląski
ing-bank-slaski.description: ING Bank Śląski is a universal bank headquartered in Katowice, Poland. Established in 1989, it provides retail, corporate, and institutional banking services. Since 1996, it has been majority-owned by the Dutch banking corporation ING Group.

isuzu.name: Isuzu
isuzu.description: Isuzu Motors Ltd. is a Japanese multinational automobile manufacturer headquartered in Yokohama, Kanagawa Prefecture. It specializes in the production, marketing, and sale of commercial vehicles and diesel engines.

informa.name: Informa
informa.description: Informa plc is a British publishing, business intelligence, and exhibitions group headquartered in London. It operates in 42 countries with approximately 14,000 employees and owns brands such as Fan Expo and Taylor & Francis. The company is listed on the London Stock Exchange and is part of the FTSE 100 Index.

inner-mongolia-yitai-coal-company.name: Inner Mongolia Yitai Coal Company
inner-mongolia-yitai-coal-company.description: Inner Mongolia Yitai Coal Company is a coal mining and production company based in Ordos City, China. Founded in 1997, it operates in mining, production, transport, and sale of coal and coal-based products. It holds the seventh largest coal reserve in the world by potential carbon emissions.

idexx-laboratories-inc.name: IDEXX Laboratories, Inc.
idexx-laboratories-inc.description: IDEXX Laboratories, Inc. is an American multinational corporation that develops, manufactures, and distributes products and services for veterinary, livestock, poultry, water testing, and dairy markets. Founded in 1983, it is headquartered in Westbrook, Maine, and Hoofddorp, Netherlands, serving customers in over 175 countries.

ignitis.name: Ignitis
ignitis.description: Ignitis Group is a state-owned energy holding company based in Vilnius, Lithuania. It operates Lithuania’s electricity distribution network and manages a green generation portfolio, providing electricity, natural gas, solar, and other energy services.

integrated-device-technology.name: Integrated Device Technology
integrated-device-technology.description: Integrated Device Technology, Inc. was an American semiconductor company headquartered in San Jose, California. It designed and marketed mixed-signal semiconductor products for communications, computing, and consumer industries before being acquired by Renesas Electronics.

insta360.name: Insta360
insta360.description: Arashi Vision Inc., doing business as Insta360, is a Chinese camera and imaging technology company headquartered in Shenzhen with offices in Los Angeles, Tokyo, and Berlin. It produces action cameras, 360-degree cameras, and video editing software. Insta360 has collaborated with Leica Camera on imaging technology.

intelsat.name: Intelsat
intelsat.description: Intelsat S.A. is a Luxembourgish-American multinational satellite services provider with headquarters in Luxembourg and Tysons, Virginia. It was originally formed as an intergovernmental consortium managing communications satellites from 1964 to 2001.

iluka-resources.name: Iluka Resources
iluka-resources.description: Iluka Resources is an Australian resources company specializing in mineral sands exploration, project development, operations, and marketing. Formed in 1998 through a merger, it is a major global producer of zircon and titanium dioxide–derived rutile and synthetic rutile, with operations in Australia and past business in the US and Sierra Leone.

intersil.name: Intersil
intersil.description: Intersil is an American semiconductor company headquartered in Milpitas, California. Founded in 1967 by Jean Hoerni, it initially focused on analog electronics and later developed CMOS designs including early electronic watches and the Intersil 6100 single-chip PDP-8 computer implementation.

ic-group.name: IC Group
ic-group.description: IC Group is a clothing company based in Copenhagen, Denmark. It operates in the clothing industry.

infomaniak-sa.name: Infomaniak SA
infomaniak-sa.description: Infomaniak is a Swiss technology company offering sustainable and privacy-focused online services. It is Switzerland's largest cloud computing company, providing cloud storage and webmail services through kSuite.

israel-shipyards-industries-ltd.name: Israel Shipyards Industries Ltd
israel-shipyards-industries-ltd.description: Israel Shipyards is a large shipbuilding and repair facility located at Kishon Port in the eastern Mediterranean. The company also operates a privately owned port adjacent to its shipyard near Haifa International Airport. It is based in Israel.

ispace-inc.name: ispace Inc
ispace-inc.description: ispace Inc. is a publicly traded Japanese company developing robotic spacecraft and technology for transportation and exploration missions. Its mission is to enable clients to discover, map, and utilize natural lunar resources. The company operates in the space industry and is based in Japan.

infrastrutture-wireless-italiane.name: Infrastrutture Wireless Italiane
infrastrutture-wireless-italiane.description: Infrastrutture Wireless Italiane S.p.A. (INWIT) is an Italian public company headquartered in Milan. It operates in the wireless network infrastructure sector, providing services related to wireless communication networks.

itamar-medical-ltd.name: Itamar Medical Ltd
itamar-medical-ltd.description: Itamar Medical is a multinational medical device company headquartered in Caesarea, Israel. It focuses on devices related to respiratory sleep disorders and is owned by ZOLL Medical Corporation. The company provides diagnostic devices for sleep disorders and early diagnosis of atherosclerosis.

iguatemi-empresa-de-shopping-centers-s-a.name: Iguatemi Empresa de Shopping Centers S.A.
iguatemi-empresa-de-shopping-centers-s-a.legal_name: Iguatemi Empresa de Shopping Centers S.A.
iguatemi-empresa-de-shopping-centers-s-a.description: Iguatemi is the third largest Brazilian company involved in the creation, planning, development, and administration of shopping centers. It holds shareholdings in 16 shopping malls, one premium outlet, and three office towers totaling 657,000 m² of gross leasable area. The company serves approximately 10 million customers monthly.

listings.name: Iguatemi Empresa de Shopping Centers S.A.

international-meal-company.name: International Meal Company
international-meal-company.description: International Meal Company (IMC) is a Brazilian holding company in the food service sector operating fast food restaurants. Founded in 2006, it operates 386 restaurants across Brazil and several other Latin American countries. Its brands include Viena, Frango Assado, Wraps, and others.

immersion-corporation.name: Immersion Corporation
immersion-corporation.description: Immersion Corporation is a developer and licensor of touch feedback (haptic) technology based in Aventura, Florida. Founded in 1993 by Louis Rosenberg, it is currently led by CEO and general counsel Francis Jose.

indigo.name: IndiGo
indigo.description: IndiGo is an Indian low-cost airline headquartered in Gurgaon, Haryana. It is the largest airline in India by passengers carried and operates over 2,700 daily flights to 137 destinations. Its primary hub is Indira Gandhi International Airport in Delhi.

innovent-biologics.name: Innovent Biologics
innovent-biologics.description: Innovent Biologics, Inc. is a publicly listed Chinese biopharmaceutical company headquartered in Suzhou, Jiangsu.

ishares.name: iShares
ishares.description: iShares is a collection of exchange-traded funds and index mutual funds managed by BlackRock. The brand was acquired from Barclays in 2009, and its first ETFs were originally called World Equity Benchmark Shares (WEBS).

industrie-de-nora.name: Industrie De Nora
industrie-de-nora.description: Industrie De Nora S.p.A. is an Italian multinational company based in Milan operating in the electrochemical industry. It is the world's leading supplier of electrodes for major industrial electrochemical processes.

impress.name: Impress
impress.description: Impress Holding, Inc. is a Japanese publishing and digital media company known for operating the IT news website Impress Watch. It publishes books, articles, and magazines related to the tech industry and the internet. The company is recognized as a pioneer in publishing internet-related books.

intertek.name: Intertek
intertek.description: Intertek Group plc is a British multinational company headquartered in London, England. It provides assurance, inspection, product testing, and certification services. The company is listed on the London Stock Exchange and is part of the FTSE 100 Index.

inspur.name: Inspur
inspur.description: Inspur Group is a Chinese information technology conglomerate focusing on cloud computing, big data, servers, storage, artificial intelligence, and ERP. It changed its English name from Langchao to Inspur in 2006 and is listed on the SSE, SZSE, and SEHK stock exchanges.

icom-incorporated.name: Icom Incorporated
icom-incorporated.description: Icom Inc. is a Japanese manufacturer of radio transmitting and receiving equipment founded in 1954. Its products serve radio amateurs, pilots, maritime, land mobile professional applications, and radio scanner enthusiasts.

iliad.name: Iliad
iliad.description: Iliad SA is a French telecommunications company headquartered in Paris. It operates fixed and mobile telephony, broadband, and IPTV services in France, Italy, and Poland under various brands including Free and Play.

irpc-public-company-limited.name: IRPC Public Company Limited
irpc-public-company-limited.description: IRPC Public Company Limited is a Thai petroleum and petrochemical company listed on the Stock Exchange of Thailand. It is a subsidiary of PTT Group and was formerly known as Thai Petrochemical Industry Public Company Limited.

intuit.name: Intuit
intuit.description: Intuit Inc. is an American financial technology company headquartered in Mountain View, California. Founded in 1983, it develops financial software and services including TurboTax and QuickBooks, and has expanded through acquisitions such as Credit Karma and Mailchimp.

iren.name: IREN
iren.description: IREN Ltd is an Australian company headquartered in Sydney that provides cloud computing infrastructure and services for artificial intelligence. It develops and operates data centres globally, focusing on renewable energy usage. The company also operates Bitcoin mining facilities transitioning to support its AI cloud business.

industrial-bank-co.name: Industrial Bank Co.
industrial-bank-co.description: The Industrial Bank Co., Ltd., officially Fujian Industrial Bank Joint-Stock Corporation, Limited, is a commercial bank based in Fuzhou, Fujian province, China. In 2023, it was ranked 60th in the Forbes Global 2000 list. The bank operates within the Chinese financial sector.

inchcape-plc.name: Inchcape plc
inchcape-plc.description: Inchcape plc is a British multinational automotive distribution company headquartered in London, England. It originated from the Calcutta-based Mackinnon Mackenzie Company and operates in 38 countries worldwide. Inchcape is listed on the London Stock Exchange and is part of the FTSE 250 Index.

innospec.name: Innospec
innospec.description: Innospec Inc. is an American specialty chemical company formerly known as Octel Corporation. It operates three business units: Performance Chemicals, Fuel Specialties, and Oilfield Services, serving markets including personal care, fuel additives, and drilling chemicals.

investors-bank.name: Investors Bank
investors-bank.description: Investors Bank was a publicly traded full-service bank based in Short Hills, New Jersey. It operated over 150 branches across New Jersey and New York.

igb-electronica.name: IGB Electronica
igb-electronica.description: IGB Eletrônica S.A., known as Gradiente, is a Brazilian consumer electronics company based in Manaus with offices in São Paulo. It designs and markets various product lines including video, audio, home theater, and mobile stereo products for the Brazilian market.

iridium-communications.name: Iridium Communications
iridium-communications.description: Iridium Communications Inc. is an American satellite communications company headquartered in McLean, Virginia. It operates the Iridium satellite constellation of 80 satellites for worldwide voice and data communication. The company also hosts space-based ADS-B receivers through its subsidiary Aireon.

invitrogen.name: Invitrogen
invitrogen.description: Invitrogen is a brand under Thermo Fisher Scientific in the United States, offering biotechnology products such as machines and consumables for PCR, cloning, cell therapy, immunotherapy, DNA/RNA purification, diagnostic tests, antibodies, and immunoassays. It is part of a larger corporation specializing in scientific products.

iseki.name: Iseki
iseki.description: Iseki & Co., Ltd. is a Japanese agricultural machinery manufacturer based in Matsuyama and Tokyo. It is the third largest in Japan and produces tractors, combine harvesters, rice transplanters, mowers, tillers, components, and diesel engines.

iqiyi.name: iQIYI
iqiyi.description: iQIYI is a Chinese subscription video on-demand streaming service owned by Baidu. It distributes original and acquired films and television shows across various genres. The service was formerly known as Qiyi.

immunogen-inc.name: ImmunoGen Inc.
immunogen-inc.description: ImmunoGen, Inc. was a biotechnology company focused on developing antibody-drug conjugate therapeutics for cancer treatment. Founded in 1981, it was headquartered in Waltham, Massachusetts.

isle-of-capri-casinos.name: Isle of Capri Casinos
isle-of-capri-casinos.description: Isle of Capri Casinos, Inc. was a gaming company headquartered in Creve Coeur, Missouri. It operated casinos and associated entertainment and lodging facilities in the United States.

internet-gold-golden-lines-ltd.name: Internet Gold Golden Lines Ltd
internet-gold-golden-lines-ltd.description: Internet Gold Golden Lines Ltd. is a principal communication service group based in Israel. Founded in 1992, it is a subsidiary of Eurocom Communications Ltd. and owns subsidiaries such as B Communications and GoldMind Ltd. The company changed its name from Euronet Golden Lines Ltd. to Internet Gold - Golden Lines Ltd. in 1999.

ihi-corporation.name: IHI Corporation
ihi-corporation.description: IHI Corporation is a Japanese engineering company headquartered in Tokyo. It produces ships, space launch vehicles, aircraft engines, marine diesel engines, gas turbines, railway systems, turbochargers, industrial machinery, power station boilers, and suspension bridges among other products.

imax-corporation.name: IMAX Corporation
imax-corporation.description: IMAX Corporation is a Canadian production theatre company founded in Montreal in 1967 and headquartered in Mississauga. It designs and manufactures IMAX cameras and projection systems and handles film development, production, post-production, and distribution to IMAX-affiliated theatres worldwide.

inpex.name: Inpex
inpex.description: INPEX Corporation is a Japanese oil company established in 1966. It is Japan's largest oil and gas exploration and production company with projects in 20 countries. INPEX was ranked as the 597th-largest public company globally in the 2020 Forbes Global 2000.

ioi-group.name: IOI Group
ioi-group.description: IOI Corporation Berhad is a major Malaysian conglomerate incorporated in 1969. It expanded into oil palm plantations in 1983, property development in 1984, and refineries in 1997. IOI is listed on Bursa Malaysia, formerly the Kuala Lumpur Stock Exchange.

iamgold.name: Iamgold
iamgold.description: Iamgold Corporation is a Canadian company headquartered in Toronto that owns and operates gold mines in Burkina Faso and Canada. Incorporated in 1990, it has also owned stakes in mines in Mali, Botswana, and Quebec. The company is publicly traded on the Toronto and New York Stock Exchanges.

incitec-pivot.name: Incitec Pivot
incitec-pivot.description: Incitec Pivot Limited is an Australian multinational corporation that manufactures fertiliser, explosives chemicals, and mining services. It is the largest fertiliser supplier in Australia and a leading explosives supplier globally. The company was formed from a merger in 2003 and expanded through acquisitions in 2006 and 2008.

insurance-australia-group.name: Insurance Australia Group
insurance-australia-group.description: Insurance Australia Group Limited (IAG) is a multinational insurance company headquartered in Sydney, Australia. It is the largest general insurance company in Australia and New Zealand, with origins in the National Roads and Motorists' Association (NRMA).

interface-inc.name: Interface, Inc.
interface-inc.description: Interface, Inc. is a global manufacturer of commercial flooring headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia. The company produces modular carpet tiles, luxury vinyl tile, and rubber flooring under the Nora brand. It operates in the textile industry.

international-flavors-fragrances.name: International Flavors & Fragrances
international-flavors-fragrances.description: International Flavors & Fragrances Inc. (IFF) is an American corporation headquartered in New York City. It creates products across taste, texture, scent, nutrition, enzymes, cultures, soy proteins, and probiotics categories and operates facilities in 44 countries. The company is a member of the S&P 500 index.

international-game-technology.name: International Game Technology
international-game-technology.description: International Game Technology (IGT) was an American gaming company based in Las Vegas that manufactured and distributed slot machines and gambling technology. It was acquired in 2015 by GTECH, which then adopted the IGT name.

internet-initiative-japan.name: Internet Initiative Japan
internet-initiative-japan.description: Internet Initiative Japan is a Japanese telecommunications company founded in 1992 by Koichi Suzuki. It is recognized as Japan’s first Internet service provider (ISP).

investec.name: Investec
investec.description: Investec is an Anglo-South African international banking and wealth management group founded in Johannesburg, South Africa. It provides a range of financial products and services to clients in Europe, Southern Africa, and Asia-Pacific.

ipsos.name: Ipsos
ipsos.description: Ipsos Group S.A. is a multinational market research and consulting firm headquartered in Paris, France. Founded in 1975 by Didier Truchot, it has been publicly traded on Euronext Paris since July 1, 1999.

iron-mountain-incorporated.name: Iron Mountain Incorporated
iron-mountain-incorporated.description: Iron Mountain Inc. is a global enterprise information management services company headquartered in Boston, Massachusetts. Founded in 1951, it provides records management, information destruction, and data backup and recovery services to customers worldwide.

infortrend.name: Infortrend
infortrend.description: Infortrend Technology is a Taiwanese technology company specializing in SAN and NAS storage systems. It is headquartered in the Zhonghe District of New Taipei, Taiwan, with regional headquarters in Tokyo, Sunnyvale, Beijing, and Munich.

insperity.name: Insperity
insperity.description: Insperity, Inc. is a professional employer organization headquartered in Kingwood, Houston, Texas. It provides human resources and administrative services to small and medium-sized businesses. Since 2004, it has sponsored a professional golf tournament on the Champions Tour.

interoil.name: InterOil
interoil.description: InterOil Corporation was an oil and gas company focused on Papua New Guinea, with assets including one of Asia's largest undeveloped gas fields, Elk-Antelope. It was formed in 1997, incorporated in Canada, and had main offices in Singapore and Port Moresby before being acquired by Exxon.

impax-asset-management-group.name: Impax Asset Management Group
impax-asset-management-group.description: Impax Asset Management Group plc is a specialist asset manager based in London, England. The company focuses on asset management services and is headquartered in the United Kingdom.

infosonics-corporation.name: InfoSonics Corporation
infosonics-corporation.description: InfoSonics Corporation was an American company that developed, manufactured, and distributed wireless handsets and accessories under its brand verykool and other private labels. It sold products through carriers, distributors, and OEMs worldwide.

intercept-pharmaceuticals.name: Intercept Pharmaceuticals
intercept-pharmaceuticals.description: Intercept Pharmaceuticals, Inc. is an American biopharmaceutical company incorporated in 2002. It focuses on developing synthetic bile acid analogs to treat chronic liver diseases and related disorders.

intersect-ent.name: Intersect ENT
intersect-ent.description: Intersect ENT, a subsidiary of Medtronic based in Menlo Park, California, manufactures drug-delivery devices for Ear, Nose & Throat clinicians. It developed the first bioabsorbable drug-eluting sinus stent PROPEL and holds numerous patents worldwide.

ipc-healthcare.name: IPC Healthcare
ipc-healthcare.description: IPC Healthcare, Inc. operated a national physician group practice delivering hospital medicine and related services across over 1,900 facilities in 28 U.S. states. It was acquired by TeamHealth in 2015.

ironwood-pharmaceuticals.name: Ironwood Pharmaceuticals
ironwood-pharmaceuticals.description: Ironwood Pharmaceuticals, Inc. is a publicly traded pharmaceutical company in the United States. It was originally known as Microbia, Inc.

imperial-hotel.name: Imperial Hotel
imperial-hotel.description: Imperial Hotel, Ltd. operates hotels in Japan, with its flagship being the Imperial Hotel, Tokyo. The company is headquartered in the Chiyoda Ward of Tokyo, near the Imperial Palace, Hibiya Park, and Ginza. It is part of the hotel industry in Japan.

indiana-resources-ltd.name: Indiana Resources Ltd
indiana-resources-ltd.description: Indiana Resources is a dual-listed iron ore mining and base and precious metals exploration company based in Perth, Western Australia. It was the first Australian iron ore company to operate the rotainer bulk export system and was listed on the Australian Stock Exchange in 1994.

invocare-limited.name: Invocare Limited
invocare-limited.description: InvoCare Limited was an Australian company with funeral interests in Australia, New Zealand, and Singapore. It employed around 2,000 people globally.

invepar.name: Invepar
invepar.description: Invepar S.A. is a private urban mobility and transit infrastructure management company headquartered in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil. It holds 11 concessions in toll roads, airports, and urban mobility through subsidiaries and joint ventures.

imris.name: IMRIS
imris.description: IMRIS, founded in 2005, is a global provider of intraoperative imaging solutions. The company specializes in medical equipment and operates internationally. It is known for its focus on advanced imaging technology used during surgeries.

idt-corporation.name: IDT Corporation
idt-corporation.description: IDT Corporation is a multinational company headquartered in Newark, New Jersey, providing cloud communications, point of sale systems, unified communications, and financial foreign exchange services. It serves both business and consumer markets, including the Boss Revolution prepaid phone cards.

indivior.name: Indivior
indivior.description: Indivior is an American pharmaceuticals company focused on substitution products for opioid addiction. It was established as a division of Reckitt Benckiser in 1994 and became independent in 2014. The company is listed on the London Stock Exchange and NASDAQ.

interactive-brokers.name: Interactive Brokers
interactive-brokers.description: Interactive Brokers Group, Inc. is an American multinational brokerage and financial services company based in Greenwich, Connecticut. It offers automated trade execution and custody services for various financial products worldwide.

igate-patni.name: IGATE Patni
igate-patni.description: IGATE Corporation was an IT services company headquartered in Bridgewater, New Jersey, operating globally across North America, Asia, Europe, Japan, and Australia. It provided technology consultancy and services and was acquired by Capgemini in 2015.

italia-independent-group.name: Italia Independent Group
italia-independent-group.description: Italia Independent Group S.p.A. is an Italian holding corporation that produces and distributes eyewear and sunglasses. It operates within Italy and focuses on eyewear products.

innogy.name: Innogy
innogy.description: innogy SE was an energy company based in Essen, Germany. It has since merged and integrated into the German energy company E.ON. The company operated in the energy supply sector.

idemitsu-kosan.name: Idemitsu Kosan
idemitsu-kosan.description: Idemitsu Kosan Co., Ltd. is a Japanese petroleum company that owns and operates oil platforms and refineries. It produces and sells petroleum, oils, and petrochemical products, and operates gas stations under the apollostation brand and formerly under Idemitsu and Shell brands, with Shell used under license.

instacart.name: Instacart
instacart.description: Instacart, officially Maplebear Inc., is a US-based retail media and delivery company headquartered in San Francisco. It operates a grocery delivery and pick-up service in the US and Canada, allowing customers to order groceries online with personal shoppers handling the shopping and delivery.

indosat-ooredoo-hutchison.name: Indosat Ooredoo Hutchison
indosat-ooredoo-hutchison.description: PT Indosat Tbk, trading as Indosat Ooredoo Hutchison, is an Indonesian telecommunications provider owned by Ooredoo Hutchison Asia. It offers wireless mobile phone services under the IM3 and Three brands, as well as broadband internet and other telecom services.

indigo-canada.name: Indigo
indigo-canada.description: Indigo Books & Music Inc. is a Canadian bookstore chain operating stores in all ten provinces and one territory. It offers books, toys, home décor, stationery, and gifts, and has expanded to music and audio equipment sales. It is Canada's largest book, gift, and specialty toy retailer.

intuitive-surgical.name: Intuitive Surgical
intuitive-surgical.description: Intuitive Surgical, Inc. is an American biotechnology company that develops robotic products to improve clinical outcomes through minimally invasive surgery, notably the da Vinci Surgical System. It is listed on Nasdaq-100, S&P 100, and S&P 500.

ibotta.name: Ibotta
ibotta.description: Ibotta, Inc. is a mobile technology company based in Denver, Colorado. Founded in 2011, it offers cash back rewards through its app and the Ibotta Performance Network, partnering with consumer packaged goods brands and publishers. The company operates solely in the United States.

ikegami-tsushinki.name: Ikegami Tsushinki
ikegami-tsushinki.description: Ikegami Tsushinki Co., Ltd. is a Japanese manufacturer of professional and broadcast television equipment, especially video cameras for news gathering and studio use. The company was founded in 1946.

israel-land-development-company.name: Israel Land Development Company
israel-land-development-company.description: Israel Land Development Company is one of Israel's largest conglomerates with activities in real estate, construction, energy, and hotels. It was acquired in 1987 by Yaakov Nimrodi. The company is based in Israel and operates in the real estate sector.

israel-electric-corporation.name: Israel Electric Corporation
israel-electric-corporation.description: Israel Electric Corporation is the largest electrical power supplier in Israel and the Palestinian territories. It builds, maintains, and operates power generation stations, substations, and transmission and distribution networks throughout Israel.

isramco-negev-2-limited-partnership.name: Isramco Negev 2 Limited Partnership
isramco-negev-2-limited-partnership.description: Isramco Negev 2 Limited Partnership is an American Israeli publicly traded master limited partnership holding interests in oil and gas properties in Israel. Founded in 1989 by Isramco Inc. and others, its shares trade on the Tel Aviv Stock Exchange and it is part of the TA-35 Index.

iveco.name: Iveco
iveco.description: Iveco Group N.V. is an Italian multinational transport vehicle manufacturing company headquartered in Turin. It designs and builds light, medium, and heavy commercial vehicles and has production plants in Europe, China, Australia, and Latin America. The company was formed in 1975 after a merger of Italian, French, and German brands.

iqvia-holdings-inc.name: IQVIA Holdings, Inc.
iqvia-holdings-inc.description: IQVIA Holdings, Inc. is an American health information technology and clinical research company headquartered in Durham, North Carolina. It provides clinical research services, healthcare analytics, technology solutions, and commercial outsourcing to pharmaceutical, biotechnology, medical device, and healthcare organizations worldwide.

isa-cteep.name: ISA CTEEP
isa-cteep.description: Companhia de Transmissão de Energia Elétrica Paulista (ISA CTEEP) is a transmission system operator of the electric power grid in Brazil. The company is headquartered in São Paulo and plays a key role in the country's energy infrastructure.

ito-en.name: Ito En
ito-en.description: Ito En, Ltd. is a Japanese multinational drinks company specializing in tea production, distribution, and sales. It is the largest green tea distributor in Japan and operates subsidiaries worldwide. The company also produces private label drinks and acquired Tully's Coffee's business in Japan.

im-financial-group.name: iM Financial Group
im-financial-group.description: IM Financial Group Co., Ltd. is a financial holding company headquartered in Daegu, South Korea. Its flagship company, IM Bank, is one of the largest regional banks in the country, primarily serving the Daegu-Gyeongbuk region.

itv-plc.name: ITV plc
itv-plc.description: ITV plc is a British media company based in London, England. It holds 13 of the 15 regional television licences that make up the ITV network. ITV is the oldest and largest commercial terrestrial television network in the United Kingdom.

icade.name: Icade
icade.industry: Rental of land and other real estate
icade.description: Icade SA is a multinational real estate investment trust headquartered in Issy-les-Moulineaux, Paris, France. It is a subsidiary of Caisse des dépôts et consignations and invests in healthcare, offices, business parks, housing, and public facilities. Icade is one of France's largest property businesses and a leading commercial real estate company in Île-de-France.

ingram-micro.name: Ingram Micro
ingram-micro.industry: Wholesale of computers, computer peripheral equipment and software
ingram-micro.description: Ingram Micro Holding Corporation is an American distributor of information technology products and services based in Irvine, California. Founded in 1979, it has evolved from a traditional distributor to a platform-based business focused on B2B digital experiences.

ingrad.name: Ingrad
ingrad.description: PJSC INGRAD is a Russian investment and development holding company headquartered in Moscow. It operates in the real estate development sector.

idbi-bank.name: IDBI Bank
idbi-bank.description: IDBI Bank Limited is an Indian Scheduled Commercial Bank owned by Life Insurance Corporation of India and the Government of India. Established in 1964 as a development finance institution and subsidiary of the Reserve Bank of India, it provides financial services primarily to the industrial sector.

imagineer.name: Imagineer
imagineer.description: Imagineer Co., Ltd. is a Japanese company involved in the content industry. It provides content and services related to characters, games, and education. The company operates in Japan.

indofood.name: Indofood
indofood.description: Indofood is an Indonesian producer of various foods and drinks headquartered in Jakarta. Established in 1990, it exports food ingredients to Australia, Asia, and Europe. The company operates in the food industry.

impinj.name: Impinj
impinj.description: Impinj, Inc. is an American manufacturer of radio-frequency identification (RFID) devices and software headquartered in Seattle, Washington. Founded in 2000, it produces EPC Class 1, Gen 2 passive UHF RFID chips, readers, antennas, and software applications for encoding and business intelligence. The company originated from research at Caltech.

imperial-oil.name: Imperial Oil
imperial-oil.description: Imperial Oil Limited is a Canadian petroleum company and the country's second-largest integrated oil company. It is majority-owned by ExxonMobil and produces crude oil, diluted bitumen, and natural gas. The company also supplies Esso-brand service stations.

iansa.name: IANSA
iansa.description: IANSA is a Chilean company engaged in sugar growing, refining, and manufacturing sweeteners and sugar products. It also produces fruit juices, tomato paste, and pet and animal food.

ionq.name: IONQ
ionq.description: IonQ, Inc. is an American quantum computing hardware and software company based in College Park, Maryland. It develops general-purpose trapped ion quantum computers and software to generate, optimize, and execute quantum circuits.

iflytek.name: iFlytek
iflytek.description: iFlytek is a partially state-owned Chinese information technology company established in 1999. It develops voice recognition software and over ten voice-based internet and mobile products across education, communication, music, and intelligent toys industries. China Mobile is its largest shareholder.

ichitan.name: Ichitan
ichitan.description: Ichitan Group Co., Ltd. is a Thai beverage company that produces green tea drinks, herbal drinks, fruit drinks, and energy drinks. It is based in Thailand and operates in the food and beverage industry.

invacare.name: Invacare
invacare.description: Invacare is a global manufacturer and distributor of non-acute medical equipment such as wheelchairs and mobility scooters. Headquartered in Elyria, Ohio, it operates worldwide and emerged from Chapter 11 bankruptcy in 2024.

ingenic-semiconductor.name: Ingenic Semiconductor
ingenic-semiconductor.description: Ingenic Semiconductor is a Chinese fabless semiconductor company founded in 2005 and based in Beijing. It designs CPU microarchitectures based on licensed MIPS architecture and system on a chip products. The company commissions fabrication of integrated circuits and sells them.

invesco.name: Invesco
invesco.description: Invesco Ltd. is an investment management company organized in Bermuda with principal offices in Atlanta, Georgia. It serves clients in 120 countries worldwide.

intellia-therapeutics.name: Intellia Therapeutics
intellia-therapeutics.description: Intellia Therapeutics, Inc. is an American clinical-stage biotechnology company developing novel therapeutics using CRISPR-based technologies. Its programs include in vivo gene editing therapies and ex vivo engineered human cell therapies for cancer and autoimmune diseases.

international-game-technology-united-sta.name: International Game Technology
international-game-technology-united-sta.description: International Game Technology PLC (IGT) is a multinational gambling company that produces slot machines and other gambling technology. It is headquartered in London and has offices in Rome, Providence, Rhode Island, and Las Vegas. The company is controlled with a 42 percent stake by De Agostini.

ingersoll-rand.name: Ingersoll Rand
ingersoll-rand.description: Ingersoll Rand Inc. is an American multinational company providing industrial products. It was formed in 2020 through the spinoff of the industrial segment of Ingersoll-Rand plc and its merger with Gardner Denver.

ibiden.name: Ibiden
ibiden.description: Ibiden Co., Ltd. is a Japanese electronics company headquartered in Ogaki, Gifu prefecture. It manufactures electronics-related products such as printed circuit boards and IC packaging, and also produces ceramics products including particulate filters for diesel engines, holding a 50% market share in Europe.

itron.name: Itron
itron.description: Itron, Inc. is an American technology company headquartered in Liberty Lake, Washington. It provides products and services for energy and water resource management, including devices that measure and analyze electricity, gas, and water consumption. The company also offers control technology, communications systems, software, and consulting services.

ipark-hyundai-development-company.name: IPARK Hyundai Development Company
ipark-hyundai-development-company.description: HDC Hyundai Development Company was created in 2018 through a spin-off from HDC Group's holding company. The South Korean company is active in real estate development, construction, and hospitality sectors.

iberiabank-corporation.name: IberiaBank Corporation
iberiabank-corporation.description: IBERIABANK Corporation was an American financial holding company headquartered in Lafayette, Louisiana. Founded in 1887, it was the largest bank based in the state with numerous branches and wealth management locations across 12 states.

icf-international.name: ICF International
icf-international.description: ICF International, Inc. is an American publicly traded consulting and technology services company based in Reston, Virginia. It provides professional services and technology solutions.

icg-group.name: ICG Group
icg-group.description: ICG Group, originally known as Internet Capital Group, Inc., was a venture capital firm based in the United States. It changed its name to Actua Corporation in 2014 and underwent liquidation in 2018. The company had a market capitalization of over $50 billion during the dot com bubble.

icu-medical.name: ICU Medical
icu-medical.description: ICU Medical, Inc. is a medical technology company based in San Clemente, California. It designs products to prevent bloodstream infections and protect healthcare workers from exposure to infectious diseases and hazardous drugs. Its product line includes intravenous therapy products, pumps, and needle-free vascular access devices.

idec-corporation.name: IDEC Corporation
idec-corporation.description: IDEC Corporation is a Japanese manufacturer of automation and control products founded in Osaka in 1945. It produces electromechanical control products such as relays, timers, and switches, as well as automation products like programmable logic controllers and touchscreen displays.

idex-corporation.name: IDEX Corporation
idex-corporation.description: IDEX Corporation is a global industrial company based in Northbrook, Illinois. It develops, designs, and manufactures fluidics systems, optics systems, fire and rescue equipment, and other specialty engineered products. The company operates in approximately 20 countries.

ig-port.name: IG Port
ig-port.description: IG Port, Inc. is a Japanese holding company established in 2007 from the merger of anime studio Production I.G and manga publisher Mag Garden. It operates in the video game and entertainment industry.

inox-leisure-limited.name: INOX Leisure Limited
inox-leisure-limited.description: PVR INOX Limited is an Indian multiplex chain formed in 2023 by merging PVR Cinemas and INOX Leisure. PVR pioneered the multiplex revolution in India with the first modern multiplex in 1997. As of 2025, it operates 1,743 screens across 352 properties in India and Sri Lanka.

ion-geophysical.name: ION Geophysical
ion-geophysical.description: ION Geophysical was a technology-focused company based in the United States that provided advanced acquisition equipment, software, planning, and seismic processing services. It also offered seismic data libraries to the global oil and gas industry.

irc-limited.name: IRC Limited
irc-limited.description: IRC Limited is a Hong Kong-based mining company engaged in the production and development of industrial commodities, primarily iron ore. It operates in the Russian Far East near the border with China and is listed on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange.

iress.name: IRESS
iress.description: Iress is an Australian technology company providing software to the financial services industry across Asia-Pacific, North America, Africa, and Europe. Its software supports over 500,000 users globally with more than 200 integrations and 300 data feeds.

itt-technical-institute.name: ITT Technical Institute
itt-technical-institute.description: ITT Technical Institute was a private for-profit technical institute headquartered in Carmel, Indiana, with many campuses across the United States. Founded in 1969, it grew to 130 campuses in 38 states before closing in 2016.

icahn-enterprises.name: Icahn Enterprises
icahn-enterprises.description: Icahn Enterprises L.P. is an American publicly traded master limited partnership and conglomerate headquartered in Sunny Isles Beach, Florida. It has investments in energy, automotive, food packaging, metals, real estate, and home fashion, and is controlled by Carl Icahn.

ichibanya.name: Ichibanya
ichibanya.description: Ichibanya Co., Ltd. is a Japanese food services company based in Ichinomiya, Aichi. It operates in the food service industry in Japan.

iconix-brand-group.name: Iconix Brand Group
iconix-brand-group.description: Iconix Brand Group, Inc. is an American brand management company that licenses brands to retailers and manufacturers. It primarily operates in the apparel, footwear, and apparel accessory industries.

idacorp.name: Idacorp
idacorp.description: IDACORP, Inc is an electricity holding company incorporated in Idaho with headquarters in Boise. It comprises Idaho Power Company, IDACORP Financial, and Ida-West Energy and was formed on October 1, 1998.

incyte.name: Incyte
incyte.description: Incyte Corporation is an American multinational pharmaceutical company headquartered in Wilmington, Delaware. It operates manufacturing and R&D locations in North America, Europe, and Asia.

independent-financial.name: Independent Financial
independent-financial.description: Independent Bank is a bank headquartered in Grand Rapids, Michigan. It operates 62 branches, all located within Michigan.

indiamart.name: IndiaMART
indiamart.description: IndiaMART InterMESH Ltd is an Indian B2B online marketplace company headquartered in Noida. Founded in 1996, it operates the IndiaMART.com portal connecting Indian manufacturers with buyers.

india-cements.name: India Cements
india-cements.description: The India Cements Limited is a cement manufacturing company based in Chennai. It is the 9th largest listed cement company in India by revenue and was headed by former ICC chairman N. Srinivasan.

india-infoline.name: India Infoline
india-infoline.description: IIFL Finance Limited, also known as India Infoline Finance Limited, is an Indian diversified financial services company headquartered in Mumbai. Founded by Nirmal Jain, it is backed by investors including Prem Watsa and General Atlantic.

indocement.name: Indocement
indocement.description: PT Indocement Tunggal Prakarsa Tbk. is one of the largest cement producers in Indonesia. It operates multiple factories and business units covering cement manufacturing, sales, ready-mix concrete, aggregates, and trass.

indus-towers.name: Indus Towers
indus-towers.description: Indus Towers Limited is an Indian telecommunications infrastructure company that offers passive infrastructure services to mobile network operators and wireless service providers. It is headquartered in Gurugram, Haryana. The company was incorporated in 2007 by Bharti Infratel, Vodafone Essar, and Idea Cellular to provide shared telecom infrastructure on a non-discriminatory basis.

inergy.name: Inergy
inergy.description: Inergy, L.P. is an American supplier of propane based in Kansas City, Missouri. It serves 800,000 customers across 28 states and is the fourth-largest propane retailer in the United States. The company also operates a major salt mining business through its U.S. Salt LLC subsidiary, with salt caverns used for natural gas storage.

infinera.name: Infinera
infinera.description: Infinera Corporation was an American manufacturer based in San Jose, California, specializing in Wavelength-division multiplexing (WDM) packet optical transmission equipment. It served the telecommunications service provider market and was a pioneer in designing and manufacturing large-scale photonic integrated circuits (PICs).

inghams-enterprises.name: Inghams Enterprises
inghams-enterprises.description: Ingham's is a supplier and producer of poultry and fodder in Australia and New Zealand. Founded in 1918, it is one of the largest producers of chicken and turkey products in Australia. The company was family-managed until 2014 and was acquired by TPG Capital that year before being listed on the Australian Securities Exchange in 2016.

ingles.name: Ingles
ingles.description: Ingles Markets, Inc. is an American supermarket chain based in Black Mountain, North Carolina. It operates 198 supermarkets in the Appalachian region of the Southeastern United States. The company is publicly traded on NASDAQ and is part of the Global Select Market tier.

innodata.name: Innodata
innodata.description: Innodata Inc. is an American company providing business process, technology, and consulting services. It offers products that help clients create, manage, use, and distribute digital information. The company was formerly known as Innodata Isogen, Inc.

inovalon.name: Inovalon
inovalon.description: Inovalon is an American technology company that provides cloud-based tools for the healthcare industry. It focuses on delivering technology solutions to support healthcare services.

insight-enterprises.name: Insight Enterprises
insight-enterprises.description: Insight Enterprises Inc. is a global technology company based in Arizona, United States. It focuses on business-to-business and information technology services for enterprises. The company operates in 19 countries and is listed on the Fortune 500.

irb-re.name: IRB(Re)
irb-re.description: IRB(Re), formally IRB-Brasil Resseguros S.A., is the largest reinsurance company in Brazil. It was founded as a state-owned enterprise and was the sole provider of reinsurance in Brazil for nearly seventy years until the market opened to private and foreign competition.

integrated-electrical-services.name: Integrated Electrical Services
integrated-electrical-services.description: IES Holdings, Inc., formerly Integrated Electrical Services, Inc., is a United States-based company that designs and installs integrated electrical and technology systems. It provides infrastructure products and services to data centers, residential housing, and commercial and industrial facilities.

interdigital.name: InterDigital
interdigital.description: InterDigital, Inc. is an American technology research and development company founded in 1972. It provides wireless and video technologies for mobile devices, networks, and services worldwide. The company is listed on Nasdaq and included in the S&P 600 index.

interactive-intelligence.name: Interactive Intelligence
interactive-intelligence.description: Interactive Intelligence, Inc. was a telecommunications software and cloud computing company based in the United States. It provided unified business communications solutions for call centers, Voice over IP companies, and business process automation.

icg-plc.name: ICG plc
icg-plc.description: ICG plc is a private equity investment firm headquartered in London, United Kingdom. It provides capital to help companies grow through private and public markets and offers various strategies and funds for institutional investors. The company is part of the FTSE 100 Index and has offices in 18 other countries.

international-bancshares-corporation.name: International Bancshares Corporation
international-bancshares-corporation.description: International Bancshares Corporation is a bank holding company based in Laredo, Texas, United States. Its primary subsidiary is International Bank of Commerce. The company operates 217 banking offices and 315 ATMs serving 88 communities in Texas and Oklahoma.

international-bank-of-commerce.name: International Bank of Commerce
international-bank-of-commerce.description: International Bank of Commerce (IBC) is a state-chartered bank headquartered in Laredo, Texas, United States. Owned by International Bancshares Corporation, it is one of the largest banks based in Texas and the largest minority-owned bank in the U.S.

international-coal-group.name: International Coal Group
international-coal-group.description: International Coal Group, Inc. is a coal mining company headquartered in Teays Valley, West Virginia. Incorporated in 2004, it operated 12 mining complexes in Appalachia and one in the Illinois Basin. In 2011, it became a subsidiary of Arch Coal, Inc.

international-road-dynamics.name: International Road Dynamics
international-road-dynamics.description: International Road Dynamics Inc. is a Canadian company headquartered in Saskatoon, Saskatchewan. It specializes in road traffic management systems including automated toll roads, commercial vehicle inspection systems, traffic data collection products, and traffic management software.

ihlas-media-holding.name: İhlas Media Holding
ihlas-media-holding.description: İhlas Holding A.Ş. is a Turkish conglomerate with media assets including the Türkiye newspaper and TGRT TV and radio networks. It also operates in construction, electrical appliances, trade, energy, mining, health, and education. The company has been listed on the Istanbul Stock Exchange since 1994.

intevac.name: Intevac
intevac.description: Intevac, Inc. was a producer of thin film deposition systems and equipment for manufacturing hard disk drives. It was headquartered in Silicon Valley, Santa Clara, California, with offices in China, Malaysia, and Singapore.

intralinks.name: IntraLinks
intralinks.description: Intralinks is an American financial technology provider founded in 1996. It focuses on enterprise collaboration and strategic transactions and was acquired by SS&C Technologies in 2018.

intrepid-potash.name: Intrepid Potash
intrepid-potash.description: Intrepid Potash, Inc. is a fertilizer manufacturer based in Denver, Colorado. It is the only producer of potassium chloride in the United States and owns three mines in the Western US near Carlsbad, New Mexico, Moab, Utah, and Wendover, Utah.

inversiones-y-representaciones-sociedad-.name: Inversiones y Representaciones Sociedad Anónima
inversiones-y-representaciones-sociedad-.description: Inversiones y Representaciones Sociedad Anónima is an Argentinian corporation engaged in the real estate business. It is 64% controlled by Cresud S.A.C.I.F. y A. The company operates with Argentinian capital.

investment-ab-latour.name: Investment AB Latour
investment-ab-latour.description: Investment AB Latour is a Swedish investment company controlled by businessman Gustaf Douglas and his family. Gustaf Douglas passed away on 3 May 2023. The company is based in Sweden.

ipca-laboratories.name: Ipca Laboratories
ipca-laboratories.description: Ipca Laboratories Limited is an Indian multinational pharmaceutical company headquartered in Mumbai. It manufactures over 350 finished-dosage formulations and around 80 active pharmaceutical ingredients, selling products in more than 100 countries.

intuitive-machines.name: Intuitive Machines
intuitive-machines.description: Intuitive Machines, Inc. is a space exploration company headquartered in Houston, Texas, founded in 2013. It provides lunar surface transportation, payload delivery, data transmission, and infrastructure services. NASA has awarded it multiple lunar surface delivery contracts under the Commercial Lunar Payload Services initiative.

isetan-mitsukoshi-holdings.name: Isetan Mitsukoshi Holdings
isetan-mitsukoshi-holdings.description: Isetan Mitsukoshi Holdings Ltd. is a holding company with Mitsukoshi and Isetan department stores as its wholly owned subsidiaries. It is based in Japan.

isrotel-ltd.name: Isrotel Ltd.
isrotel-ltd.description: Isrotel Ltd. is an Israeli hotel chain headquartered in Tel Aviv. It operates 21 hotels and resorts throughout Israel, mostly in and around Eilat.

issta-lines-ltd.name: Issta Lines Ltd.
issta-lines-ltd.description: Issta Lines is a publicly traded tourism company founded in 1956 and listed on the Tel Aviv Stock Exchange. The Issta Group operates over 60 branches, call centers, and online travel services throughout Israel and employs over 1000 permanent employees domestically and abroad.

iwatsu-electric.name: Iwatsu Electric
iwatsu-electric.description: Iwatsu Electric, Co., Ltd. is a Japanese electronics manufacturer founded on August 14, 1938. The company is listed on the Tokyo Stock Exchange under the ticker 6704.

impala-platinum.name: Impala Platinum
impala-platinum.description: Impala Platinum Holdings Limited, or Implats, is a South African holding company that owns mines producing platinum group metals, nickel, copper, and cobalt. Its key operations include the Impala mine in North West province and other mines in South Africa and Zimbabwe. The company also operates Impala Refining Services and formed Impala Canada in 2019.

isracard-ltd.name: Isracard Ltd
isracard-ltd.description: Isracard is an Israeli company composed of four companies including Isracard LTD and American Express Israel. It offers financial services such as credit card issuing, loans, credit services, and flexible payment options.

innovate-corp.name: Innovate Corp.
innovate-corp.description: Innovate Corp. is an American public financial services company founded in 1994. It operates within the financial services sector in the United States.

icr-inbursa.name: ICR Inbursa
icr-inbursa.description: Inbursa is a Mexican financial company providing banking and related services through subsidiaries. Its business lines include investment funds, insurance, mortgages, retirement funds, and commercial banking, and it is owned by billionaire Carlos Slim.

icon-plc.name: ICON plc
icon-plc.description: Icon plc is a multinational clinical research organization headquartered in Ireland. It conducts clinical trials and provides drug development services for pharmaceutical and biotechnology companies.

ingredion.name: Ingredion
ingredion.description: Ingredion Inc. is a US-based food and beverage ingredient provider headquartered in Westchester, Illinois. It produces starches, non-GMO sweeteners, stevia, and pea protein from various plant sources for food, beverage, brewing, pharmaceutical, and industrial sectors.

intercontinental-exchange.name: Intercontinental Exchange
intercontinental-exchange.description: Intercontinental Exchange, Inc. is an American multinational financial services company operating global financial exchanges and clearing houses. It also provides technology and services for mortgage loan origination, closing, and servicing.

iovance-biotherapeutics.name: Iovance Biotherapeutics
iovance-biotherapeutics.description: Iovance Biotherapeutics, Inc. is a biopharmaceutical company based in Philadelphia, Pennsylvania. It focuses on developing tumor-infiltrating lymphocyte (TIL) therapies to treat cancer.

imerys.name: Imerys
imerys.description: IMERYS S.A. is a French multinational company specializing in the production and processing of industrial minerals. It is headquartered in Paris and is part of the CAC Mid 60 index.

ibex-35.name: IBEX 35
ibex-35.description: The IBEX 35 is the benchmark stock market index of the Bolsa de Madrid, Spain's main stock exchange. It includes the 35 most liquid Spanish stocks and is administered by Sociedad de Bolsas, a subsidiary of Bolsas y Mercados Españoles.

informatica.name: Informatica
informatica.description: Informatica Inc. is an American software development company founded in 1993 and based in Redwood City, California. Its core products include enterprise cloud data management and data integration.

idea-cellular.name: Idea Cellular
idea-cellular.description: Idea Cellular Limited was an Indian telecommunications company based in Mumbai, Maharashtra. It was an integrated GSM operator with 220 million subscribers as of June 2018.

iran-khodro.name: Iran Khodro
iran-khodro.description: Iran Khodro, branded as IKCO, is an Iranian automaker headquartered in Tehran. Founded in 1962 as Iran National, it manufactures vehicles including Samand, Peugeot, Renault cars, trucks, minibuses, and buses.

icr-at-t-mexico.name: ICR AT&T México
icr-at-t-mexico.description: AT&T Mexico is a Mexican mobile telephone operator and subsidiary of AT&T. It is headquartered in Mexico City and covers 90% of Mexico with its mobile network. AT&T Mexico is the third-largest wireless carrier in the country.

iran-post.name: Iran Post
iran-post.description: Iran Post is a government-owned corporation responsible for postal services in Iran. It operates as the national postal service provider within the country. The company is state-operated and manages mail delivery across Iran.

imbel.name: IMBEL
imbel.description: Indústria de Material Bélico do Brasil (IMBEL) is a Brazilian Ministry of Defence quango founded in 1975. It coordinates industrial activity related to the planning and production of war material through technology transfer and financial and technical support for new military development.

inwi.name: Inwi
inwi.description: Inwi is a telecommunications company based in Morocco, founded in 2009. It operates as a subsidiary of the Moroccan holding Al Mada and the Kuwaiti group Zain.

industria-naval-do-ceara.name: Indústria Naval do Ceará
industria-naval-do-ceara.description: Indústria Naval do Ceará (INACE) is a shipbuilding company located in Fortaleza, Brazil. It specializes in shipbuilding activities within the country.

imagination-technologies.name: Imagination Technologies
imagination-technologies.description: Imagination Technologies Group Limited is a British semiconductor and software design company headquartered in Kings Langley, England. It designs PowerVR graphics processors for AI processing and is owned by Canyon Bridge Capital Partners.

inmarsat.name: Inmarsat
inmarsat.description: Inmarsat is a British satellite telecommunications company providing mobile telephone and data services worldwide. It operates through fifteen geostationary telecommunications satellites and offers services via portable or mobile terminals.

interxion.name: Interxion
interxion.description: Interxion is a provider of carrier and cloud-neutral colocation data centre services in Europe. Founded in 1998 in the Netherlands, it is headquartered in Schiphol-Rijk and operates 53 data centres across 11 European countries. It was publicly listed on the NYSE until its acquisition by Digital Realty in 2020.

inmobiliaria-colonial.name: Inmobiliaria Colonial
inmobiliaria-colonial.description: Inmobiliaria Colonial is a Spanish multinational corporation involved in real estate. It operates a Real Estate Investment Trust (REIT) and its activities include property rental, land, and development. The company is based in Spain.

industrial-alliance.name: Industrial Alliance
industrial-alliance.description: iA Financial Group is a Canadian insurance and wealth management company operating in Canada and the United States. It is one of the largest public companies in Canada. The group provides various financial services.

indykpol.name: Indykpol
indykpol.description: Indykpol is one of Poland's largest poultry processors and the largest turkey processor, headquartered in Olsztyn. Founded in 1991 as a successor to a state-owned corporation, it became a joint-stock company in 1993 and has been listed on the Warsaw Stock Exchange since 1994.

irkutskenergo.name: Irkutskenergo
irkutskenergo.description: Irkutskenergo is a Russian power company that primarily focuses on generating hydroelectricity.

infinis.name: Infinis
infinis.description: Infinis Energy is a British renewable energy group headquartered in Northampton. It produces electricity from captured landfill and mineral methane. The company operates in the renewable energy sector.

interserve.name: Interserve
interserve.description: Interserve was a British construction and support services company based in Reading, Berkshire. It went into administration in 2019 and was formally wound up in 2022, having generated £2.2 billion in revenue and employed over 34,000 people in 2019.

ironsource.name: IronSource
ironsource.description: ironSource Ltd. was an Israeli software company focused on developing technologies for app monetization and distribution. Its core products targeted the app economy.

iseq-20.name: ISEQ 20
iseq-20.description: The ISEQ 20 is a benchmark stock market index composed of the 20 companies with the highest trading volume and market capitalization on Euronext Dublin. It was started on December 31, 2004, and is used to compare the performance of Irish stocks.

inovio-pharmaceuticals.name: Inovio Pharmaceuticals
inovio-pharmaceuticals.description: Inovio Pharmaceuticals, Inc. is an American biotechnology company focused on synthetic DNA products for treating cancers and infectious diseases. In 2020, it was among companies developing a COVID-19 vaccine candidate.

imi-plc.name: IMI plc
imi-plc.description: IMI plc is a British engineering company headquartered in Birmingham, England. Formerly known as Imperial Metal Industries Limited, it is listed on the London Stock Exchange and is part of the FTSE 100 Index.

innergex-renewable-energy.name: Innergex Renewable Energy
innergex-renewable-energy.description: Innergex Renewable Energy Inc. develops, owns, and operates run-of-river hydroelectric, wind, and solar energy facilities. It operates in North America, France, and South America, with many assets in Québec and expansions into Ontario, British Columbia, Idaho, Chile, and France.

intact-financial.name: Intact Financial
intact-financial.description: Intact Financial Corporation is a Canadian general insurance holding company and the largest provider of property and casualty insurance in Canada. It operates subsidiaries and brands across Canada, the UK, Ireland, Europe, and the United States. The company was formed in 2009 and is publicly traded on the Toronto Stock Exchange.

ig-group.name: IG Group
ig-group.description: IG Group Holdings plc is a United Kingdom-based online trading and investment provider. It offers access to spread betting, US futures and options, stock and crypto trading, allowing traders to speculate on equities, bonds, and currencies without owning the underlying assets.

icad-inc.name: iCAD Inc.
icad-inc.description: iCAD Inc. is a medical device manufacturer based in Nashua, New Hampshire, USA. The company offers computer aided detection technology to support detection of breast, prostate, and colorectal cancers. It also provides hardware and software for radiation therapy treatment.

ip-group.name: IP Group
ip-group.description: IP Group plc is a British-based early-stage investor that backs IP-based technology companies. It is based in London, England, and is listed on the London Stock Exchange as a constituent of the FTSE 250 Index.

intermap-technologies.name: Intermap Technologies
intermap-technologies.description: Intermap Technologies is a publicly traded company headquartered in Douglas County, Colorado, United States. It provides geospatial solutions and 3D terrain products used by GIS professionals in commercial and government sectors worldwide, including energy, engineering, and telecommunications.

international-forest-products.name: International Forest Products
international-forest-products.description: Interfor Corporation is one of the largest lumber producers globally, based in Vancouver, British Columbia. It operates sawmills with a large manufacturing capacity and sells lumber across North America, Asia-Pacific, and Europe. In 2014, it opened a corporate office in Peachtree City, Georgia for the US southeast region.

iran-khodro-diesel.name: Iran Khodro Diesel
iran-khodro-diesel.description: Iran Khodro Diesel Company manufactures commercial vehicles in Iran and other countries in the Middle East, CIS, and Africa. It operates under license from Daimler-Benz of Germany and holds about 80% of the bus market in Iran.

iranian-aluminium-company.name: Iranian Aluminium Company
iranian-aluminium-company.description: Iranian Aluminium Company (IRALCO) is the largest aluminum producer in Iran, located in Arak. Its plant covers 232 hectares and produces various aluminum products including pure ingots and electrical conductors.

itautec.name: Itautec
itautec.description: Itautec is a Brazilian electronics company founded in 1979. It operates as a division of the Itaúsa group, a Brazilian business group. The company is involved in the software industry.

iwg-plc.name: IWG plc
iwg-plc.description: International Workplace Group plc, formerly Regus, is a Swiss-based company providing serviced offices and coworking spaces under several brand names including Regus. Founded in Brussels, Belgium in 1989, it is registered in Jersey and headquartered in Zug, Switzerland. The company is listed on the London Stock Exchange and is part of the FTSE 250 Index.

innoson-motors.name: Innoson Motors
innoson-motors.description: Innoson Vehicle Manufacturing Co. Ltd. is a Nigerian automobile manufacturer headquartered in Nnewi, Anambra. Founded by Chief Innocent Chukwuma Nwala, it is nicknamed the Pride Of African Roads.

intercontinental-bank.name: Intercontinental Bank
intercontinental-bank.description: Intercontinental Bank was a Nigerian commercial bank operating from 1989 until its acquisition by Access Bank plc in 2013. It was one of the twenty-four commercial banks licensed by the Central Bank of Nigeria. The bank provided financial services in Nigeria.

interswitch.name: Interswitch
interswitch.description: Interswitch is a Lagos-based integrated payment and digital commerce platform company founded in 2002. It started as a transaction switching and processing company and expanded to consumer financial services with products like Quickteller and Verve.

irs-airlines.name: IRS Airlines
irs-airlines.description: IRS Airlines Limited was an airline based in Abuja, Nigeria. It operated scheduled domestic passenger services with its main base at Nnamdi Azikiwe International Airport. The airline was established in 2002 and ceased operations in 2013.

international-bank-of-somalia.name: International Bank of Somalia
international-bank-of-somalia.description: The International Bank of Somalia (IBS) is a bank headquartered in Mogadishu, Somalia.

i-m-bank-limited.name: I&M Bank Limited
i-m-bank-limited.description: I&M Bank Kenya Limited is a commercial bank licensed by the Central Bank of Kenya, the national banking regulator. It operates in Kenya, the largest economy in the East African Community.

industry-federation-of-the-state-of-rio-.name: Industry Federation of the State of Rio de Janeiro
industry-federation-of-the-state-of-rio-.legal_name: Industry Federation of the State of Rio de Janeiro
industry-federation-of-the-state-of-rio-.description: The Industry Federation of the State of Rio de Janeiro (FIRJAN) is a Brazilian industrial federation representing industries in Rio de Janeiro. It promotes debates, research, and projects for sustainable development and provides services to affiliated companies.

ipe.name: IPE
ipe.description: Indústria Paranaense de Estruturas Ltda, known as IPE Aeronaves, is an aircraft manufacturer based in Curitiba, Paraná, Brazil. The company specializes in producing gliders and general aviation aircraft. It operates within the aerospace industry.

internet-group-do-brasil.name: Internet Group do Brasil
internet-group-do-brasil.description: Internet Group do Brasil (iG) is a Brazilian internet service provider that operates web portals and offers services including news, shopping, and financial information. It provided free email accounts until 2016.

illovo-sugar.name: Illovo Sugar
illovo-sugar.description: Illovo Sugar South Africa is a sugar producer founded in 1891 and headquartered in uMhlanga, KwaZulu-Natal. It is a wholly-owned subsidiary of UK-based ABF Sugar and sources sugar cane from ten farms.

interair-south-africa.name: Interair South Africa
interair-south-africa.description: Interair South Africa was a privately owned airline headquartered in Johannesburg, South Africa. It operated scheduled passenger services from Johannesburg to regional African destinations, with its main base at O. R. Tambo International Airport. The airline focused on regional connectivity.

imperial-air-cargo.name: Imperial Air Cargo
imperial-air-cargo.description: Imperial Air Cargo was a cargo airline based in Johannesburg, South Africa. It operated domestic overnight express cargo services, focusing on fast cargo delivery within the country. The airline served the logistics sector.

iguanabee.name: IguanaBee
iguanabee.description: IguanaBee is a Chilean video game company known for developing MonsterBag, a stealth video game released in 2015 for the PlayStation Vita. The company operates in the video game industry.

icbc-argentina.name: ICBC Argentina
icbc-argentina.description: ICBC Argentina is an Argentine banking entity owned by the Industrial and Commercial Bank of China. It was founded in 2013 after acquiring Standard Bank Argentina and serves as the Argentine subsidiary of the Chinese bank.

intercorp.name: Intercorp
intercorp.description: Intercorp Perú Ltd. is a Peruvian business conglomerate and multinational corporation founded in 1994. It operates primarily through two holding companies, Intercorp Financial Services and Intercorp Retail. Its headquarters are located in Santa Catalina, Lima, in the same building as its subsidiary Interbank.

interbank.name: Interbank
interbank.description: Interbank, formally Banco Internacional del Perú Service Holding S.A.A., is a Peruvian financial services provider. It operates in the banking sector within Peru.

inter.name: Inter
inter.description: Inter is a Venezuelan television broadcaster and telecommunications provider headquartered in Barquisimeto, Lara. Founded in 1996 as InterCable, its fiscal name is Corporacion Telemic C.A. The main shareholder of Inter is the investment fund HM Capital Partners.

indumil.name: Indumil
indumil.description: INDUMIL is a Colombian military weapons manufacturer operated by the Colombian government. It specializes in producing arms and is based in Colombia.

international-airlink.name: International AirLink
international-airlink.description: AirLink Express is a Jamaican air charter airline based at Sir Donald Sangster International Airport in Montego Bay. It offers charter and scheduled services to all airports in Jamaica and operates aircraft including the Cessna 208B Grand Caravan.

institut-francais-d-archeologie-oriental.name: Institut Français d'Archéologie Orientale
institut-francais-d-archeologie-oriental.industry: Research and development in humanities and social sciences
institut-francais-d-archeologie-oriental.description: The Institut français d'archéologie orientale is a French research institute based in Cairo, Egypt. It focuses on archaeology, history, and languages of Egypt's various civilizational periods.

izzi.name: Izzi
izzi.description: izzi is a Mexican telecommunications company owned by Grupo Televisa and operated by Televisión Internacional, S.A. de C.V. It provides telephone, Internet, cable TV, and mobile services to individuals and companies in cities across Mexico. izzi is listed on the Mexican Stock Exchange.

italika.name: Italika
italika.description: Italika is a Mexican motorcycle brand established in 2004 by Ricardo Salinas Pliego. It operates two assembly plants in Mexico and distributes motorcycles across Mexico, Guatemala, and Honduras. Italika is the top-selling motorcycle brand in Mexico with over eight million customers.
